policies.title: RDS storage encryption
policies.description: Require explicit storage encryption for supported AWS RDS instances and clusters, including resolvable cluster members.
policies.scope_description: Standalone RDS instances and RDS clusters; Aurora members inherit only from a unique same-plan cluster with known matching identifier and AWS ARN context. Unresolved associations are indeterminate; service defaults and live state are not inferred.

policies.title: S3 bucket public-access protection

policies.title: Unrestricted SSH ingress
policies.description: Detect observed ingress rules permitting direct TCP SSH from an individual world-wide IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR.
policies.scope_description: Observed inline ingress and standalone ingress rules only. Prefix-list contents remain unresolved; live reachability and unions of narrower CIDRs are not analyzed.

DATA_SOURCE_SKIPPED.explanation: Data sources are excluded from desired-state governance.
DATA_SOURCE_SKIPPED.remediation: No remediation is required for this check.

DELETED_RESOURCE_SKIPPED.explanation: Deleted resources have no desired-state encryption check.
DELETED_RESOURCE_SKIPPED.remediation: No remediation is required for this check.

RESOURCE_NOT_SUPPORTED.explanation: This resource is outside the selected policy scope.
RESOURCE_NOT_SUPPORTED.remediation: No remediation is required for this check.

SSH_EGRESS_SKIPPED.explanation: Outbound rules are outside this ingress policy.
SSH_EGRESS_SKIPPED.remediation: No remediation is required for this check.

SSH_INLINE_UNRESTRICTED_INGRESS.explanation: An observed ingress permission allows unrestricted direct SSH.
SSH_INLINE_UNRESTRICTED_INGRESS.remediation: Restrict the source of SSH access or remove the ingress permission.

SSH_INLINE_NO_UNRESTRICTED_INGRESS.explanation: No unrestricted direct SSH permission was established in the observed scope.

policies.title: Mandatory resource tags
policies.description: Require known nonblank strings for startup-required tag keys; defaults are Environment, Owner and Project. --required-tag-key overrides the complete default list.
policies.scope_description: Five supported resource types; observed desired tags_all is authoritative, with tags fallback only when tags_all is provably absent. Unknown/sensitive observations remain uncertain. Ignored/external tags and live AWS state are not inferred; absence is an observed-plan violation, not proof of absence in AWS.
